Name: Kenneth's Gemstone Trees
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Tired of hunting for gemstones in the mines? Grow them![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Gemstone Trees adds 7 new fruit-tree saplings that grow into beautiful gemstone trees. Each tree produces its own gemstone during its season, just like vanilla fruit trees.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Amethyst Tree - Summer, 100% daily chance[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Aquamarine Tree - Winter, 95% daily chance[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Diamond Tree - Winter, 35% daily chance (rare)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Emerald Tree - Spring, 70% daily chance[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Jade Tree - Spring, 90% daily chance[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Ruby Tree - Fall, 70% daily chance[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Topaz Tree - Fall, 100% daily chance[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each tree takes 28 days to mature, then produces every day in its season based on its daily chance.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Works like vanilla fruit trees[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced - rarer gems have lower daily chance[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Seasonal - encourages planning, just like apple and peach trees[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Vanilla-friendly - uses vanilla gemstone items[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - no scripts, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 1.6 compatible[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 13 Languages Supported - English, Filipino/Tagalog (Philippines), Spanish, Italian, German, French, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hungarian[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Seed Shop (Required) - Saplings are available at Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: Does not overwrite vanilla trees. Works alongside my other mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation: Drop into Mods folder and run with SMAPI.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Original Art & Inspiration:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]This is a Content Patcher 1.6 conversion of the Json Assets mod by Wandox99. All original sprites and tree art are by Wandox99. Permission was granted by Wandox99 to update and convert the JA version to CP 1.6.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Original JA version by Wandox99: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15521[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Happy farming![/b][/size]
